## Executive Summary
Autonomous systems and forward-deployed automation engineer with an M.Tech in Control and Instrumentation from MNNIT Allahabad and a B.Tech in Electronics and Communication Engineering from RCOEM Nagpur. Operates at the intersection of embedded hardware, deterministic edge runtimes, real-time computer vision, and industrial systems automation. Lead author of peer-reviewed edge-perception research published in IEEE Xplore (Document ID: 10627276). Proven track record of delivering production-grade client-side engines executing under 50ms latency (npl-automation.pages.dev), software-defined radio (SDR) spectral sensing pipelines for UAV RF classification, and ROS2 embedded robotics control stacks.

## Core Technical Competencies
- Autonomous Robotics & Embedded: ROS2 (composition nodes, lifecycle management), Embedded Linux, Microcontrollers (Raspberry Pi, Arduino), Serial Protocols (CAN, UART, SPI, I2C), Sensor Synchronization (LiDAR, Monocular Vision, IMU), Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL).
- Applied AI & Edge Perception: Real-Time Computer Vision (YOLOv5, OpenCV), Model Quantization (INT8), Edge Compute Optimization, Spectral Feature Extraction, Machine Learning (TensorFlow, Keras, Scikit-Learn).
- RF Telemetry & Signal Processing: Software-Defined Radio (SDR), RF Signal Classification, Spectrogram Analysis, IQ Signal Parsing, UAV Flight Controller Telemetry Interception.
- Production Systems & Cloud: Cloudflare Pages, Deterministic Parsing Algorithms, Client-Side Runtime Optimization, AWS (EC2, Lambda, S3, SageMaker), RESTful APIs, Git, Docker, Shell Scripting.

- Real-Time Drone Detection & RF Signal Classification: Automated edge spectral sensing pipeline intercepting UAV flight controller communications across 2.4 GHz & 5.8 GHz ISM bands via SDR, FFT spectrograms, and lightweight neural classification. - CardsFinders Financial Tool Suite: Global edge-delivered comparison platform on Cloudflare Pages with edge DNS and mail routing. Live: https://cardsfinders.com/

- Photovoltaic Sensorless Solar Tracker: Closed-loop dual-axis solar tracking using intrinsic panel voltage/current as sensor (NO external LDRs) with dynamic MPPT. Architecture: https://docs.google.com/presentation/d/1WsoxJpkOGv4GCKoAZFYMt03jj_0Yq4AvVkb0T4s2bPY/edit?usp=sharing | Demo: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1fcZVVkoQ_b0vqO3GWKNmk0JH5dNND53V/view?usp=sharing
